{{Meta |missing_NPC_picture = yes |missing_NPC_location = yes |missing_NPC_context = yes |missing_NPC_profile = yes |missing_NPC_idle = yes }} {{Stub}} {{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Xiaotang.png |type = Open-World |nation = Huanglong |location = Hongzhen |group = |affiliation = |title = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} {{Lang|Xiaotang|zh= 小棠}} is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. ==Location== Xiaotang can be found near the Sagaci Springs during the day, and to the left of the Hongzhen Pioneer Association during the evening. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Hidden Quest== {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Xiaotang:''' Oh no... The box is missing... The bad guy stole it... :'''Xiaotang:''' Tabbie... Patchie... no... ---- :'''??:''' Meow- :'''Rover:''' Sounds like there's a little cat in that pile of boxes... ---- :''Destroy wooden boxes'' :'''Rover:''' Two kittens? ---- :'''Rover:''' They're not scared of humans... and look well and healthy. Someone must be taking care of them. :'''Rover:''' But why are they wandering in this place... :The tabby kitten brushes against your legs and gives out a "meee-ooow", before running off with its companions. :'''Rover:''' Are they going back home? That looks like the way to Hongzhen. ---- :'''Tabbie:''' Meow- :'''Patchie:''' Purr- :'''Xiaotang:''' Tabbie and Patchie like you very much, Big (Brother/Sister). :'''Tabbie:''' Meow, meow meow. :The tabby kitten circles around you and then meows anxiously at Little Tang. :'''Xiaotang:''' What is it, Tabbie? Hmmm, you mean this Big (Brother/Sister) saved you from the bad guy? :'''Tabbie:''' Meow. :'''Xiaotang:''' I see. Thank you so much, Big (Brother/Sister). :'''Xiaotang:''' Come on, you two. Say "Thank you!" :'''Tabbie:''' Meow! :'''Patchie:''' Meow, meow! :{{DIcon}} No trouble at all. :{{DIcon}} Why did the Exiles take them? ::'''Xiaotang:''' ...Granny told me some bad uncles and aunties are doing bad things in town recently. ::'''Xiaotang:''' Tabbie and Patchie like to sleep in the box. Maybe those bad guys thought there was a "treasure" inside, like others said, so they grabbed the box and took Tabbie and Patchie with them. :'''Xiaotang:''' I've been looking for them for quite a long time... Thank you for bringing them home safely. :{{DIcon}} Don't worry. I've taught them to behave. :'''Xiaotang:''' Wow! You are so cool! I need to be stronger and protect Tabbie and Patchie. :'''Xiaotang:''' And I made a new home for them using a beautiful new box! I put it in my home, so it's safe there. :'''Xiaotang:''' You are welcomed to come and play with us at any time! :{{DIcon}} I will. Thank you. :Xiaotang waves you goodbye as she picks up Tabbie and Patchie and hippity-hops off into the distance. {{Dialogue End}} ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} {{Description|''"What are you looking at?"''
}} ;(After saving Tabbie and Patches) :'''Qinghe:''' Hey, what is a little cat doing in the pool?! :'''Qinghe:''' Don't panic, kitty-kitty. I'll get you out of there right now! :'''Xiaotang:''' Please keep it down. The cat doesn't like loud noises when it's enjoying the hot spring. :'''Xiaotang:''' Oh, and it's name is Tiger, not kitty. :'''Qinghe:''' Enjoying the hot spring? Stop messing with me, little girl. All cats hate water. :'''Xiaotang:''' I'm not messing with you. Cats in Mt. Firmament don't. :'''Xiaotang:''' Well, that's not entirely true, I guess... They don't like the streams. Maybe they just prefer Sagaci Springs... :'''Xiaotang:''' Hey, look, Tiger heard us and is swimming our way! :'''Qinghe:''' That is odd.
